_comment: Pins for the REAL pipeline run. Null values are deliberate: a team member fills them from the actual sources at kickoff. The pipeline refuses unpinned ontology releases and records unfilled sections as failed coverage.

hpo._how: Use a versioned HPO release download (not 'latest') and the matching phenotype.hpoa; release must appear in hp.obo data-version.

mondo._how: Versioned Mondo release mondo.obo plus its SSSOM mapping product; release must appear in data-version.

_diseases_how: Mondo IDs chosen by the hour-one context audit (config/context_mapping_audit.json). Do not add IDs from memory.

pubmed._how: {"<PMID>": {"public_text_policy": "link_only|excerpt|full"}} per selected PMID; link_only unless redistribution is permitted.

_medrxiv_how: [{"doi": ..., "version": "1", "public_text_policy": "link_only", "publication_family_id": null, "document_role": "research_report|protocol"}] after checking the team's files.
_clinicaltrials_how: [{"nct": "NCT...", "condition_disease_ids": {"<condition text as registered>": "MONDO:..."}}]; unmapped conditions are not linked.
